text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document lists a total approved budget of $2,400,000.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"}]},{"text":"The adjustment is an increase of $200,000, from $2,400,000 to $2,600,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"}]},{"text":"The governance document says budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."}]},{"text":"The Finance Committee is named as having revised the budget, but the documents do not explicitly state that it approved the change before implementation.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":["The documents don't explicitly state that the Finance Committee approved the budget change before implementation."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
